gloss: medicine taken as needed (not on a regular schedule)

definitions.gloss: medicine taken as needed; on-demand medication
definitions.explanation: Medicine that is taken only when symptoms appear, rather than at regular intervals. Common examples include pain relievers, anti-anxiety medication, and fever reducers. The term is widely used in medical and pharmacy contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧{頓服|とんぷく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the as-needed medicine when you feel pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頓服|とんぷく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine is prescribed as an as-needed medication.

examples.japanese: {頓服|とんぷく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なるべく→なるべく：01281_narubeku⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I received a pain reliever to take as needed, but I try not to use it if possible.

notes:
{頓服|とんぷく} is a medical/pharmaceutical term that patients commonly encounter when receiving prescriptions. It contrasts with ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧ (regular/scheduled medication). The instruction {頓服|とんぷく} on a prescription label means the patient should take the medicine only when needed.

The word {頓|とん} here means "immediate/sudden" and {服|ぷく} means "to take (medicine)."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頓服|とんぷく}{薬|やく} — as-needed medicine
- {頓服|とんぷく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to prescribe as an as-needed medicine
- {頓服|とんぷく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to manage with as-needed medication
